SCR-Systeme mit Harnstoff-Einspritzung könnten die von der Kommission vorgeschlagenen niedrigen Konformitätsfaktoren zwar erreichen, eine schnelle Umstellung auf SCR bis 2017/2018 müsse angesichts der nötig werdenden Bauteile aber als unrealistisch eingestuft werden.
context: Robert Bosch GmbH to BMUB 12 October 2015 explaining technical constraint: most current diesel models cannot meet factor 1.6 without full SCR conversion.

label: Industry unity dissolves under regulatory pressure on compliance factors
original_label: Industry unity dissolves under regulatory pressure on compliance factors
quote: Zwischen Automobilindustrie jedoch Uneinigkeit: Ford sieht durch KOM-Vorschlag hohe Mehrkosten (+1000 € bei Fiesta) und Wirtschaftlichkeit von Dieselfahrzeugen in Gefahr und besteht auf höhere Grenzwerte und insbesondere auch auf 'Transferfunktion'. BMW wie auch Daimler halten substantielle Transferfunktion für verzichtbar.
context: Kanzleramt summary of divergent industry positions on 16 October 2015 showing fracture in auto industry coalition on RDE requirements.

label: Federal government negotiates compliance factor compromise between strict and lax positions
original_label: Federal government negotiates compliance factor compromise between strict and lax positions
quote: Der Übergangsfaktor sollte im moderaten Bereich bei 3,5 liegen und im extended bzw. 'Extrembereich' bei 5. [...] Die Unterscheidung moderate/extended sollte sich an den Randbedingungen des im Entstehen begriffenen WLTP orientieren.
context: VDA RDE background meeting 16 June 2015 proposing differentiated compliance factors for moderate vs extreme driving conditions.

label: BMUB rejects VDA concept as loophole for manipulated driving optimization
original_label: BMUB rejects VDA concept as loophole for manipulated driving optimization
quote: Es darf nicht dazu kommen, dass am Ende des RDE-Prozesses normales/übliches Fahren auf der Straße ausgeschlossen wird und nur weitgehend eingegrenzte und damit vorhersehbare Fahrten umfasst werden, auf die die Fahrzeughersteller ihre Fahrzeuge – wie heute auf den Zyklus - wieder einstellen können.
context: BMUB briefing paper for Staatssekretär Flasbarth 30 July 2015 opposing VDA moderate/extended boundary concept as creating new optimization loophole.

label: UBA finds RDE factor 2.0 or lower necessary for NO2 limit compliance by 2020
original_label: UBA finds RDE factor 2.0 or lower necessary for NO2 limit compliance by 2020
quote: Die Wahrscheinlichkeit ist hoch, dass in Städten mit geographischen Gegebenheiten wie z.B. Berlin der NO2-Immissionsgrenzwert im Jahresmittel 2020 eingehalten werden kann, wenn der mit TREMOD berechnete Trend erreicht wird. Dafür sollte der RDE-CF von 2.0 nicht überschritten werden dürfen. An heute besonders hoch belasteten verkehrsnahen Standorten, wie z.B. in Stuttgart, müssen die NO2-Minderungen über denen [sic!] des TREMOD Trends hinausgehen. Deshalb ist aus Sicht der Immission ein RDE-CF von 2,0, besser 1,5 oder kleiner zu fordern.
context: UBA answer to BMUB of 10 April 2014 on necessary RDE compliance factors to achieve NO2 air quality targets in German cities.

label: Bosch researcher notes political rather than technical resolution of RDE conflicts
original_label: Bosch researcher notes political rather than technical resolution of RDE conflicts
quote: Bänsch sieht bis zum 10. September nur noch eine politische Lösung/Entscheidung. Gemeinsames Verständnis von Politik und Industrie sehr fraglich. [...] Eine politische Entscheidung in Deutschland verliert Ministerin Hendricks klar gegen Merkel, Gabriel, Dobrindt
context: Robert Bosch GmbH internal email of 19 August 2015 from researcher noting that RDE compliance factor dispute would be decided by political choice rather than technical analysis.

label: VW's US diesel market ambitions
original_label: VW's US diesel market ambitions
quote: Gegenüber dem Gouverneur Schwarzenegger gehörte zu denen, zu den wenigen, sage ich mal, republikanischen Gouverneuren, mit denen man gut und positiv über Klimaschutz sprechen konnte, und da stand für mich im Vordergrund die Frage der Reduktion von CO2-Emissionen. Da ich die deutschen Dieselautos genau für diesen Zweck für gut hielt, kann es sein, dass ich gesagt habe: 'Mit den NOx-Emissionen hat das deutsche Dieselauto, mit den Grenzwerten hat das deutsche Dieselauto in Kalifornien keine Chance. Ist das für den Klimaschutz bezüglich der CO2-Ausstöße eigentlich eine gute Strategie?'
english_gloss: With NOx emissions, the German diesel car has no chance in California with those limit values. Is that really a good strategy for climate protection regarding CO2 emissions?
context: Chancellor Merkel recalling in 2017 testimony a 2010 conversation with California Governor Schwarzenegger about German diesel cars' inability to meet California NOx standards while maintaining CO2 performance, indicating market access pressure.

label: NEFZ test cycle inadequate for real emissions
original_label: NEFZ test cycle inadequate for real emissions
quote: Jedenfalls war mir schon in meiner Amtszeit als Umweltminister – wie übrigens vielen anderen auch – bekannt, dass es immer wieder Kritik etwa durch die Deutsche Umwelthilfe gab, die sagte, die Ergebnisse der Messungen im Labor hätten wenig mit den realen Werten zu tun. Diese Kritik war, glaube ich, auch plausibel; denn selbst die Techniker und Sachverständigen gaben zu, dass der auf europäischer Ebene definierte Laborzyklustest NEFZ, also Neuer Europäischer Fahrzyklus, genügend legale Möglichkeiten bot, um auch mit schlechteren Werten diesen Test zu bestehen.
english_gloss: Even technicians and experts admitted that the NEFZ cycle defined at the European level provided enough legal means to pass the test even with poor values.
context: Former Environment Minister Gabriel testifying in 2016 about the well-known inadequacy of the NEFZ test cycle that allowed poor emissions performance to pass legally.

label: Technical impossibility claimed for RDE compliance
original_label: Technical impossibility claimed for RDE compliance
quote: Der VDA habe dann die Idee der Transferfunktion an das BMWi herangetragen. Daraufhin sei eine vom VDA finanzierte Studie durchgeführt worden, deren Ergebnis gewesen sei, dass die Transferfunktion sich 'immissionsseitig' nicht negativ auswirke. Grund für die Finanzierung durch den VDA sei gewesen, dass nicht genügend Zeit für ein öffentlich-rechtliches Vergabeverfahren zur Verfügung gestanden habe.
english_gloss: The VDA brought the transfer function idea to the economics ministry. A VDA-funded study resulted showing the transfer function had no negative effects on emissions. The reason for VDA funding was that there was not enough time for a public procurement procedure.
context: Witness Bänsch testifying about VDA's development of transfer function concept to address claimed technical impossibility of meeting RDE test conditions without regulatory relief.

label: Time pressure prevents full assessment
original_label: Time pressure prevents full assessment
quote: Um 'die Verhandlungen zum RDE-Paket 2 nicht auszubremsen', habe man die Idee der Transferfunktion 'nicht mehr rechtzeitig abschließend diskutieren können' und sich deswegen der Idee der Kommission angeschlossen, 'für die Transferfunktion einen Platzhalter zu schaffen […] ohne konkrete Werte einzusetzen'.
english_gloss: To not slow down negotiations on RDE Package 2, they could not finish discussing the transfer function and therefore adopted the Commission's idea to create a placeholder for the transfer function without setting concrete values.
context: Witness Bänsch explaining that time pressure to finalize RDE Package 2 prevented completing technical discussions about the transfer function.

label: RDE introduction timeline pressures
original_label: RDE introduction timeline pressures
quote: Es ging uns darum, auch möglichst schnell dort zu einem Kompromiss zu kommen, der dann auch ohne Verzögerung in Kraft treten kann, weil je länger man damit wartet, desto kürzer wird die Vorlaufzeit.
english_gloss: We wanted to reach a compromise quickly there that could then come into effect without delay, because the longer you wait, the shorter the lead time becomes.
context: Witness Bänsch explaining the goal to reach a compromise quickly on RDE to maximize lead time for manufacturers.

label: Six to seven year vehicle development cycle constraint
original_label: Six to seven year vehicle development cycle constraint
quote: Der Produktionszyklus eines neuen Fahrzeugs liege 'irgendwo bei sechs, sieben Jahren'. Für eine 'vernünftige Regulierung, wenn sie eine große Industrie trifft', brauche es 'eine ausreichende Lead Time', was der VDA in den Gesprächen mit der Bundesregierung auch immer betont habe.
english_gloss: The production cycle of a new vehicle is somewhere around six, seven years. For sensible regulation when it affects a large industry, adequate lead time is needed, which the VDA always emphasized in talks with the government.
context: VDA President Wissmann testifying about the long vehicle development cycle and the industry's consistent demands for adequate lead time in regulations.

label: Diesel Euro 6 failure to meet real-world standards
original_label: Diesel Euro 6 failure to meet real-world standards
quote: Grund für diese Vorhaben seien die hohen tatsächlichen Emissionswerte bei Kfz gewesen, über die man das BMUB auch informiert habe. Der Zeuge geht aufgrund der dem UBA vorliegenden Daten davon aus, dass die RDE-Grenzwerte in der zweiten Stufe wohl nur mithilfe der SCR-Technologie einhaltbar seien.
english_gloss: The reason for these projects was the high actual emissions values from vehicles, which the environment ministry was also informed about.
context: Witness Schmied from UBA testifying in 2016 about high actual emissions from vehicles that prompted research and indicated only SCR technology could meet second-stage RDE limits.

label: PEMS measurement technology not available for passenger cars initially
original_label: PEMS measurement technology not available for passenger cars initially
quote: Allerdings ist dabei zu beachten, dass – meines Wissens nach – die Technik zur Messung der Realemissionen bei Pkw damals noch gar nicht vorhanden war bzw. bei Pkw nicht einsetzbar war. Ein mobiles Messverfahren im Straßenverkehr in der Fahrzeugzulassung, wie es jetzt EU-weit eingeführt wird, war zudem etwas völlig Neues, und Sie wissen, dass wir auch jetzt eine sozusagen stufenweise Einführung der RDE-Tests in Europa haben.
english_gloss: As far as I know, the technology for measuring real emissions on passenger cars did not exist at that time or was not usable on passenger cars.
context: Former Environment Minister Gabriel explaining in 2016 testimony why RDE development took nine years: the technology for measuring real-world passenger car emissions did not exist initially.

label: Industry-wide lobby against RDE stringency
original_label: Industry-wide lobby against RDE stringency
quote: Ferner hat der Zeuge ausgeführt: 'Das war für uns zunächst enttäuschend als Umweltministerium, weil wir ja auch mit dem Wirtschaftsministerium uns vorher schon mal auf 1,95 geeinigt hatten als Linie. Im Laufe des Tages hat sich diese Ansage aus dem Kanzleramt dann aber als günstig erwiesen, weil es doch deutliche Kräfte gab, einen schwächeren Wert als 2,1 durchzusetzen.'
english_gloss: That was initially disappointing for us as the environment ministry because we had already agreed on 1.95 as our line with the economics ministry. In the course of the day this announcement from the chancellery turned out to be favorable because there were clear forces trying to enforce a weaker value than 2.1.
context: State Secretary Flasbarth recalling pressure from other member states and industry to weaken the 2.1 conformity factor in the second RDE package.

label: Other member states demanding higher conformity factors
original_label: Other member states demanding higher conformity factors
quote: Es seien nicht einfach gewesen 'manche Länder von zum Teil überzogenen Forderungen, also Aufweichungen des Faktors, abzubringen'. So hätten unter anderem Italien, Tschechien, Österreich, Spanien, Bulgarien, Ungarn und Rumänien einen Konformitätsfaktor von 2,5 befürwortet. Er habe an den Tagen vor der Abstimmung noch seine 'italienische Kollegin am Telefonhörer' gehabt, die einen Faktor von 2,5 befürwortet habe, da ihr zufolge alles andere 'der Untergang der italienischen Automobilindustrie' sein würde.
english_gloss: It had not been easy to dissuade some countries from partly exaggerated demands, that is, weakening of the factor. Italy, Czech Republic, Austria, Spain, Bulgaria, Hungary and Romania had supported a conformity factor of 2.5.
context: Witness Gabriel testifying in 2016 about pressure from other EU member states to accept higher (weaker) conformity factors in RDE negotiations.

label: VDA lobbying for higher conformity factors
original_label: VDA lobbying for higher conformity factors
quote: Der Zeuge Dr. Eberhardt hat sich in diesem Zusammenhang eine von ihm verfasste Stellungnahme aus dem Oktober 2014 vorhalten lassen, in der er geschrieben hatte: 'Aufgrund der zeitlichen Verzögerung des Abschlusses der RDE-Arbeiten, der im Wesentlichen auf eine Vielzahl von Forderungen der Industrieseite zurückzuführen ist, wird nun angestrebt, RDE zunächst ab September 2015 für neu genehmigte Fahrzeugtypten im Rahmen eines Monitorings (also ohne Emissionsbegrenzung) und erst ab September 2017/2018 auch in Verbindung mit RDE-Emissionsanforderungen zur Anwendung zu bringen.'
english_gloss: Due to the time delay in completing RDE work, which is essentially due to a multitude of demands from the industry side, it is now being sought to apply RDE initially from September 2015 for newly approved vehicle types within a monitoring framework (i.e., without emissions limits) and only from September 2017/2018 also in connection with RDE emissions requirements.
context: Witness Dr. Eberhardt's October 2014 statement describing how industry demands for exceptions delayed RDE work, requiring a phased implementation approach.

label: Industry claims RDE unachievable without relief measures
original_label: Industry claims RDE unachievable without relief measures
quote: Der VDA halte die beschlossenen Regelungen für 'eine ebenso anspruchsvolle, aber noch machbare Regelung, die nicht dazu führt, dass Produktionen abgestellt werden müssen.' Allerdings setze der Konformitätsfaktor von 2,1 'die Betriebe unter eine gewaltige Anspannung.'
english_gloss: The VDA considered the adopted rules to be 'an equally ambitious but still feasible regulation that does not lead to production shutdowns.' However, the conformity factor of 2.1 put 'plants under tremendous strain.'
context: VDA President Wissmann testifying about industry's position that RDE limits were only barely achievable and would strain manufacturing.

label: Industry concerns about measurement uncertainty exploitation
original_label: Industry concerns about measurement uncertainty exploitation
quote: Der VDA halte es für 'eine ebenso anspruchsvolle, aber noch machbare Regelung'. Im Zusammenhang damit habe er darauf hingewiesen, dass die Gesetzgebung für die Unternehmen rechtssicher sein müsse. 'Wenn es anerkanntermaßen eine Messtoleranz gibt von 0,5 Größenordnung – manche sagen sogar: bis zu 0,8 -, und Sie kommen im ersten Jahr in eine Größenordnung von 1,5, 1,6, 1,8, dann sind die Unternehmen bei der jetzt laufenden Produktion – um die geht es – nicht mehr rechtssicher.'
english_gloss: If there is an acknowledged measurement tolerance of 0.5 magnitude—some say even up to 0.8—and you end up in a range of 1.5, 1.6, 1.8 in the first year, then companies with current production are no longer legally certain.
context: VDA President Wissmann explaining industry's legal certainty concerns about measurement tolerances and how conformity factors interact with them.

label: RDE implementation deadlines set by Commission
original_label: RDE implementation deadlines set by Commission
quote: Auch die gefundenen Fristen für RDE sind angemessen, um einerseits die notwendigen Emissionsminderungen zu erreichen, aber auch den Herstellern Übergangszeit zur technischen Anpassung der Fahrzeuge zu geben. Die Bundesregierung hätte auch kürzere Fristen unterstützt, ein schnelleres Inkrafttreten war aber im Rahmen der Verhandlungen nicht erreichbar.
english_gloss: The found timelines for RDE are appropriate to achieve necessary emissions reductions on the one hand and give manufacturers transition time for technical vehicle adaptation on the other. The federal government would have supported shorter timelines, but faster implementation was not achievable within the negotiations.
context: Government talking points on RDE implementation dates indicating preference for faster implementation but acceptance of compromise dates.

label: Rising gap between NEFZ test and real emissions
original_label: Rising gap between NEFZ test and real emissions
quote: Laut einem Medienbericht hatte das Joint Research Centre (JRC) der Europäischen Kommission bei einem Test zum Ausstoß von Stickoxid beim Fahrzeugmodell Audi A3 2.0 l Euro EA 288 im August 2016 zwei Indizien gefunden, die auf ein Abschalten der Abgasreinigung hingedeutet haben sollen. Gerade beim NEFZ-Test bei 10 °C habe der Audi A3 hiernach den NOx-Grenzwert deutlich überschritten.
context: Media reports discussed in Bundestag testimony showing JRC findings of NOx exceedances in Audi A3 tests, indicating real-world performance gap.

label: ACEA lobby for conformity factor above 3.0
original_label: ACEA lobby for conformity factor above 3.0
quote: Der Zeuge hat hierzu erläutert, dass BMVI und BMWi 'da immer relativ ähnlich in der Diskussion und auch in der Bewertung der Konformitätsfaktoren' gewesen seien. Das BMWi habe, 'abgestimmt mit dem UBA', die Automobilhersteller aufgefordert, Untersuchungen darüber zu machen, wie sich 'die Veränderung der Grenzwerte auf die Luftqualität in Städten' auswirke. Der ACEA und der VDA hätten 'auf jeden Fall einen Wert über 3' präferiert.
english_gloss: ACEA and VDA preferred 'on any account a value above 3'.
context: Witness Bänsch explaining that ACEA and VDA preferred conformity factors above 3.0 during RDE negotiations.

label: First-stage conformity factor disagreement between ministries
original_label: First-stage conformity factor disagreement between ministries
quote: Bei der Ressortabstimmung zu den Konformitätsfaktoren habe das BMUB mit einem Faktor von 1,4 nahe am Kommissionsvorschlag bleiben wollen. BMWi und BMVI hätten sich auf einen Faktor von 2,2 geeinigt. Dem habe der Zeuge im Namen des BMUB aber förmlich widersprochen.
context: State Secretary Flasbarth recalling the split between environment ministry (1.4 factor) and transport/economics ministries (2.2 factor) in internal government negotiations.

label: Industry pressure on government through leadership channels
original_label: Industry pressure on government through leadership channels
quote: Es habe auch wesentliche Diskussionen zu den Randparametern und der Begrenzung der Fahrdynamik gegeben. Im Ergebnis seien diese Diskussionen 'sicher notwendig', aber 'zeitlich sehr, sehr aufwendig' gewesen. Ob es sich um vorsätzliche Verzögerungen gehandelt habe, habe man nicht erkennen können. Der sogenannte Abgasskandal habe dann 'beschleunigend gewirkt in Hinblick auf die Entscheidungsfindung auf europäischer Ebene', in materieller Hinsicht habe er sich jedoch nicht ausgewirkt.
context: Witness Dr. Eberhardt from BMUB testifying about lengthy discussions driven by industry input on RDE parameters, creating time pressure that accelerated decision-making after VW scandal.

label: VDA intensive lobbying slowing RDE process
original_label: VDA intensive lobbying slowing RDE process
quote: Der VDA habe die Einführung von RDE 'sehr massiv […] verlangsamt', weswegen man sich bei der Einführung letzten Endes darauf eingelassen habe 'ein zweischrittiges Vorgehen zu bekommen, um überhaupt in dieses Verfahren zu kommen.' Ferner sei seitens des VDA bis zum Schluss der Verhandlungen versucht worden, höhere Konformitätsfaktoren zu erreichen.
english_gloss: The VDA had 'very significantly slowed down' the introduction of RDE, which is why they ended up agreeing to 'a two-stage approach to even enter this process.' Furthermore, the VDA attempted until the end of negotiations to achieve higher conformity factors.
context: State Secretary Flasbarth testifying in 2016 about VDA's intensive slowdown of RDE introduction and attempts to achieve higher conformity factors.

label: Ambition to achieve real-world emissions measurement
original_label: Ambition to achieve real-world emissions measurement
quote: Im Jahre der Initiierung durch die Kommission 2010 Konsens geherrscht habe, 'schnellstmöglich ein substantielles, geeignetes Verfahren zu schaffen'. Gleichwohl habe es 'widerstreitende Interessen' gegeben. Deutschland habe sich dabei im Übrigen wie 'zwei, drei andere Länder auch […] an die Spitze der Bewegung gestellt'.
english_gloss: There was consensus in the year the Commission initiated it in 2010 to create a 'substantive, suitable procedure as quickly as possible'.
context: Witness Steinkemper testifying about consensus in 2010 to establish a proper RDE procedure quickly, with Germany as a leading advocate despite conflicting interests.

label: Industry pressure on BMVI leadership over RDE parameters
original_label: Industry pressure on BMVI leadership over RDE parameters
quote: Dem Zeugen ist in diesem Zusammenhang in seiner Vernehmung eine E-Mail vorgehalten worden, die er am 12. Juni 2015 an Dr. Eberhardt vom BMUB und Herrn Bänsch vom BMWi geschrieben hatte. Darin heißt es, man sei über die Leitungsebenen massiv unter Druck gesetzt worden 'die dynamischen Randbedingungen schon im 1. Paket zu verabschieden.' Dazu hat der Zeuge erklärt, er habe damit ausdrücken wollen, dass das Ministerium von Industrieseite 'über den Weg der Leitungsebenen […] unter Druck gesetzt' worden sei.
english_gloss: They had been placed under massive pressure via leadership levels to finalize dynamic boundary conditions already in the first package. He meant to express that the ministry had been placed under pressure from industry 'via the leadership level.'
context: Witness Redmann's June 2015 email describing industry pressure transmitted through ministry leadership to include dynamic RDE parameters in first package.

label: German automotive industry dependent on favorable regulations
original_label: German automotive industry dependent on favorable regulations
quote: Natürlich war mir schon in meiner Amtszeit als Umweltminister […] bekannt, dass es immer wieder Kritik etwa durch die Deutsche Umwelthilfe gab, die sagte, die Ergebnisse der Messungen im Labor hätten wenig mit den realen Werten zu tun. […] Uns war damals schon klar, dass wir hier etwas tun müssen, um die Autos insgesamt umweltfreundlicher zu machen und Schlupflöcher zu schließen.
context: Former Environment Minister Gabriel explaining the dilemma of strong environmental criticism versus the need to support the German automotive industry.

label: RDE as solution to growing gap between lab and real emissions
original_label: RDE as solution to growing gap between lab and real emissions
quote: Grund für die Initiierung durch die Kommission 2010 Konsens geherrscht habe, 'schnellstmöglich ein substantielles, geeignetes Verfahren zu schaffen'. Gleichwohl habe es 'widerstreitende Interessen' gegeben. Deutschland habe sich dabei im Übrigen wie 'zwei, drei andere Länder auch […] an die Spitze der Bewegung gestellt'. Die RDE-Verhandlungen in Brüssel seien sehr komplex gewesen, weshalb man sie in vier Pakete unterteilt habe.
context: Witness Gabriel explaining how RDE was structured as four packages due to complexity of addressing real-world emissions measurement.

label: VW internal CO2 investigation reveals 800,000 affected vehicles
original_label: VW internal CO2 investigation reveals 800,000 affected vehicles
quote: In einer Pressemitteilung vom 3. November 2015 hatte Volkswagen die Öffentlichkeit darüber informiert, dass man bei internen Untersuchungen Unregelmäßigkeiten bei CO2-Werten verschiedener VW-Modelle festgestellt hat, von denen rund 800.000 Fahrzeuge betroffen sein könnten.
english_gloss: In a press release of 3 November 2015, Volkswagen informed the public that it had discovered irregularities in CO2 values for various VW models, affecting approximately 800,000 vehicles.
context: The report documents Volkswagen's discovery and internal communication about CO2 value irregularities affecting a large vehicle fleet, indicating performance targets were not being met.

label: Technical conflict between motorschutz and emissions control
original_label: Technical conflict between motorschutz and emissions control
quote: Wie beurteilt die Bundesregierung das Problem, dass Abgasnachbehandlungssysteme auf dem Markt üblich sind, die das Einhalten von Abgasemissionsgrenzwerten zum Schutz der Gesundheit der Bevölkerung praktisch ausschließen, weil andernfalls die Gefahr besteht, dass auch Schäden entstehen können, "welche unmittelbar den Ausfall des Motors zur Folge haben"?
english_gloss: How does the federal government assess the problem that exhaust aftertreatment systems on the market essentially preclude compliance with emission limit values to protect public health, because otherwise there is a risk of damage that could directly cause engine failure?
context: A parliamentary question posed to the German government asking how it assesses the technical problem that exhaust aftertreatment systems cannot meet emission limits without risking engine damage.

label: Motorschutz rationale for emissions shutdown in Group II vehicles
original_label: Motorschutz rationale for emissions shutdown in Group II vehicles
quote: Bei einigen der Fahrzeugmodelle deutscher Automobilhersteller, die von der Kommission in Gruppe II eingeordnet wurden, hat die Kommission im Bericht Zweifel an der Zulässigkeit der Abschalteinrichtung bzw. den Verdacht auf eine unzulässige Abschalteinrichtung geäußert... Der Zeuge Odenwald hat erläutert, bei welchen Fahrzeugen der Gruppe II sich der Hinweis findet, dass Zweifel an der Zulässigkeit der Abschalteinrichtungen bestehen: "Also, wenn Sie sich mal die Systematik unseres Berichts anschauen, dann war in dieser Kategorie II - - Explizit bei allen Fahrzeugen, wo wir Typgenehmigungsbehörde sind, wurde der Hinweis gemacht, es würden Zweifel an der Unzulässigkeit der Abschalteinrichtung aus Motorschutzgründen nicht weiter bestehen, also wenn entsprechende Maßnahmen getroffen werden."
english_gloss: For vehicles in Group II where the KBA is the type approval authority, it was noted that doubts about the illegality of the shutdown device based on engine protection grounds would cease if corresponding measures were taken.
context: The witness Odenwald explains the commission's findings on emission control shutdowns, stating that for Group II vehicles with German type approval, doubts about the legality of shutdown devices based on motorschutz (engine protection) rationale would be removed if appropriate measures were taken.

label: Sudden reduction in affected CO2 models from 130 to nine
original_label: Sudden reduction in affected CO2 models from 130 to nine
quote: Nach Information von Volkswagen vom 3. November 2015 sollen nach internen Untersuchungen rund 800.000 Dieselfahrzeuge des Volkswagen-Konzerns von Unregelmäßigkeiten bei den CO2-Werten und damit dem Kraftstoffverbrauch betroffen gewesen sein. Nur einen Monat später habe VW der Untersuchungskommission am 3. Dezember 2015 dann jedoch mitgeteilt, dass statt der zunächst befürchteten etwa 130 Modelltypen aus dem Modelljahr 2016 tatsächlich nur neun Modellvarianten betroffen seien.
english_gloss: According to Volkswagen information from 3 November 2015, approximately 800,000 diesel vehicles of the Volkswagen Group were affected by irregularities in CO2 values. However, only one month later on 3 December 2015, VW informed the investigation commission that instead of the initially feared approximately 130 model variants from model year 2016, only nine model variants were actually affected.
context: The report documents Volkswagen's dramatic revision of CO2 compliance issues, reducing the scope from 130 model variants to only nine within one month, indicating a significant change in reported internal investigation findings.

label: Testing regime prevented detection of manipulation
original_label: Testing regime prevented detection of manipulation
quote: Die Ablösung des Rollenzyklus NEFZ verschleppt. Solange die von den Herstellern selbst beauftragten Labortests die Einhaltung der Grenzwerte unter Laborbedingungen bestätigten, hielt das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt alle Anforderungen für erfüllt. Die realen Emissionen außerhalb der Prüflabore interessierten die Behörde nicht.
english_gloss: The abolition of the NEFZ test cycle was delayed. As long as manufacturer-commissioned laboratory tests confirmed compliance with limit values under laboratory conditions, the Federal Motor Transport Authority considered all requirements met. The actual emissions outside test laboratories were of no interest to the authority.
context: Report summary describing why real-world emissions never became a regulatory constraint before 2015.

label: VW's US diesel market entry required emissions compliance
original_label: VW's US diesel market entry required emissions compliance
quote: Das Signal war eindeutig und wurde von den Automobilherstellern auch so verstanden: Die Ergebnisse des NEFZ auf dem Prüfstand mussten stimmen, die Realität auf der Straße interessierte weder die Typgenehmigungsbehörde noch das Bundesverkehrsministerium. Das war eine Einladung an Hersteller, ihre Abgaskontrollsysteme in Dieselfahrzeugen unter bestimmten Bedingungen wie Prüfsituation auf dem Rollenprüfstand, Temperatur, Geschwindigkeit, Lenkwinkel, Meereshöhe usw. abzuschalten oder zu reduzieren.
english_gloss: The signal was clear and manufacturers understood it that way: NEFZ results on the test bench had to be correct, but the reality on the road interested neither the type-approval authority nor the Federal Transport Ministry. This was an invitation for manufacturers to switch off or reduce their exhaust control systems in diesel vehicles under certain conditions such as test situations on the roller test bench, temperature, speed, steering angle, altitude, etc.
context: Report explaining how the regulatory structure's indifference to real-world emissions created market conditions rewarding manipulation.

label: Federal transport ministry blocked field monitoring proposals
original_label: Federal transport ministry blocked field monitoring proposals
quote: Das Verkehrsministerium hat blockiert, als es vor zehn Jahren darum ging, die Wirksamkeit von Abgasreinigungseinrichtungen durch Feldtests zu überprüfen und dabei auch dem Verdacht auf Abschalteinrichtungen nachzugehen. Während sich das Umweltministerium und das Umweltbundesamt ernsthaft Gedanken machten, scheiterten die geplanten Feldtests am Widerstand des zuständigen Verkehrsministeriums.
english_gloss: The Transport Ministry blocked efforts a decade earlier to test the effectiveness of exhaust control devices through field tests and to investigate suspicions of defeat devices. While the Environment Ministry and Environmental Protection Agency took the matter seriously, the planned field tests failed due to resistance from the competent Transport Ministry.
context: Report finding that the transport ministry blocked environmental ministry proposals for field monitoring that could have detected the cheating.

label: Feasibility gap between NEFZ test and real driving
original_label: Feasibility gap between NEFZ test and real driving
quote: Eine unabhängige Feldüberwachung von Behörden war damals etwas, was über die Vorgaben des Regelwerks insofern hinausging, als es keine gelebte Praxis war. Die Praxis war eine Selbstüberprüfung durch die Hersteller, überprüft oder gemonitort durch ein Typgenehmigungsbehörde.
english_gloss: Independent government field monitoring was something that went beyond the regulatory specifications in that it was not established practice at the time. The practice was self-testing by manufacturers, monitored by a type-approval authority.
context: Testimony by Environment Ministry official explaining that independent field monitoring was not standard practice; only manufacturer self-testing was performed.

label: Automakers installed defeat devices to meet NEFZ while failing real-world tests
original_label: Automakers installed defeat devices to meet NEFZ while failing real-world tests
quote: Obwohl die EU-Verordnung 715/2007, wie dargestellt, den Einsatz von Abschalteinrichtungen grundsätzlich verbietet, hat die Bundesregierung an keiner Stelle geprüft, ob sich die Hersteller tatsächlich an dieses Verbot halten. Doch ein Verbot, das niemand nachprüft oder durchsetzt, ist nicht mehr wert als eine Handlungsempfehlung. Das öffnet Tür und Tor für Autohersteller, sich nicht an dieses Verbot zu halten. Weil keine Gefahr drohte, dass der Einsatz von Abschalteinrichtungen überhaupt geprüft wurde, wurden Abschalteinrichtungen durch Autohersteller offensichtlich in breitem Umfang eingesetzt.
english_gloss: Although EU Regulation 715/2007 basically prohibits the use of defeat devices, the German government never checked whether manufacturers were actually complying with this prohibition. But a prohibition that no one checks or enforces is no more than a recommendation. This opens the door for automakers not to comply with this prohibition. Because there was no risk that the use of defeat devices would be checked at all, defeat devices were apparently used by automakers on a broad scale.
context: Report concluding that lack of enforcement created conditions enabling widespread adoption of defeat devices.

label: KBA management resisted field monitoring initiation
original_label: KBA management resisted field monitoring initiation
quote: Eine unabhängige Überprüfung der Kraftfahrzeuge durch eine Verkehrsbehörde war insofern in gewisser Weise Neuland. Und dieses Neuland zu beschreiten, bedurfte einer gewissen Aktivierungsenergie. So haben das Umweltministerium und das Umweltbundesamt mit einem entsprechenden Vorstoß die Verkehrsbehörden versucht von einer Notwendigkeit zu überzeugen.
english_gloss: Independent inspection of motor vehicles by a transport authority was in a certain sense uncharted territory. And navigating this new territory required a certain amount of activation energy. So the Environment Ministry and Environmental Protection Agency tried to convince the transport authorities of the necessity with appropriate initiatives.
context: Report explaining that environmental ministry had to pressure transport authorities because field monitoring was considered too novel and required special effort to initiate.

label: Transport ministry minimized field test scope and requirements
original_label: Transport ministry minimized field test scope and requirements
quote: Erst nachdem Staatssekretär Matthias Machnig aus dem Umweltministerium erneut Druck gemacht hatte, lenkte das Verkehrsministerium ein – allerdings offenbar unter der Voraussetzung, das vom Umweltbundesamt ausgearbeitete Konzept durch die Bundesanstalt für Straßenwesen (BASt), einer nachgeordneten Behörde des Verkehrsministeriums, völlig überarbeiten zu lassen. Übrig blieb ein Bonsai-Test: Was vom Umweltbundesamt als kontinuierliche und umfassende Feldüberwachung angelegt war, war letztlich ein einmaliges Projekt mit nur wenigen Fahrzeugen. Die Prüfung auf Konstruktionsteile für das Cycle Beating wurde dabei gestrichen.
english_gloss: Only after State Secretary Matthias Machnig from the Environment Ministry renewed pressure did the Transport Ministry relent—but apparently on the condition of having the concept developed by the Environmental Protection Agency completely reworked by the Federal Road Research Institute (BASt), a subordinate authority of the Transport Ministry. What remained was a bonsai test: what the Environmental Protection Agency had designed as continuous and comprehensive field monitoring was ultimately a one-time project with only a few vehicles. The inspection for cycle-beating components was thereby eliminated.
context: Report finding that when environmental ministry pressured transport ministry, it responded by gutting the field test scope and removing cycle-beating checks.

label: BASt personnel lacked authority to pursue suspicious emissions findings
original_label: BASt personnel lacked authority to pursue suspicious emissions findings
quote: Von der BASt wurden auch mehrere VW-Golf mit der Motorenkennzeichnung 'CBAB' getestet. Hierbei handelt es sich um den Betrugsmotor EA 189. Bei den Messungen wurde festgestellt, dass zunächst die Kohlenmonoxidwerte der Fahrzeuge nicht stimmten. Nach einer Softwareaktualisierung bei den Fahrzeugen durch VW stellte sich dann heraus, dass einer der VW-Golf einen besseren CO2-Wert aufwies als die anderen Fahrzeuge. Ein beteiligter Mitarbeiter der BASt wollte diesem Umstand nachgehen, wurde jedoch von einem Mitarbeiter des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes mit der Begründung ausgebremst, die Felduntersuchung habe nicht zum Ziel, Unregelmäßigkeiten beim CO2-Ausstoß festzustellen.
english_gloss: BASt also tested several VW Golf vehicles with the engine designation 'CBAB'. This is the fraud motor EA 189. The measurements initially found that the carbon monoxide values of the vehicles were not correct. After a software update by VW on the vehicles, it turned out that one of the VW Golf vehicles showed better CO2 values than the other vehicles. An involved BASt employee wanted to investigate this finding, but was blocked by a Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt employee on the grounds that the field investigation was not intended to identify irregularities in CO2 emissions.
context: Report documenting that when BASt testers found anomalies in VW emissions data, KBA personnel blocked further investigation citing scope constraints.

label: KBA terminated investigation of suspicious VW emissions
original_label: KBA terminated investigation of suspicious VW emissions
quote: Doch da es sich um einen Einzelfall handelte, wurde man auch hier nicht aktiv: 'Für mich ergibt sich hieraus nicht die Notwendigkeit weiterer Fragestellungen an die VW AG.' Doch hätte man diese Ergebnisse kritischer hinterfragt und auch das umfassende Testprogramm des Umweltbundesamtes angewandt, so wäre man dem Dieselskandal möglicherweise bereits im Jahr 2011 auf der Spur gewesen.
english_gloss: But since it was a single case, no action was taken here either: 'For me, this does not create a necessity for further questions to Volkswagen AG.' Yet if these results had been questioned more critically and the comprehensive testing program of the Environmental Protection Agency had been applied, the diesel scandal might have been detected as early as 2011.
context: Report showing that KBA chose not to pursue anomalies in 2011 VW testing that later proved central to the scandal.

label: KBA lacked legal authority to inspect motor software
original_label: KBA lacked legal authority to inspect motor software
quote: In den Sitzungen des Untersuchungsausschusses haben die Vertreter des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes jedoch bestritten, diese Kompetenzen zu besitzen, sodass man in der Vergangenheit keine solchen Prüfungen hätte vornehmen können. Beispielsweise wurde der Zeuge Sven Paeslack, Referatsleiter Grundsatzfragen im Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt, gefragt, warum angesichts der deutlichen Lücke zwischen den gemessenen Emissionen und den Abgaswerten auf der Straße in der Vergangenheit niemand auf die Idee gekommen sei, außerhalb des festen Testzyklus zu prüfen. Es stellte sich heraus, dass dem Zeugen Paeslack nicht vorstellbar war, dass irgendjemand solche Überlegungen angestrengt hätte. Den Grund sieht er darin, dass man diese Pläne sowieso niemals hätte umsetzen können, weil wir ein relativ starres Regelwerk und Korsett haben hinsichtlich der technischen Prüfungen, die wir machen können.
english_gloss: However, representatives of the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt disputed having such competencies in committee sessions, so such tests could not have been conducted in the past. For example, witness Sven Paeslack, head of basic policy issues at the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt, was asked why, given the obvious gap between measured emissions and exhaust values on the street, no one had thought in the past to test outside the fixed test cycle. It turned out that witness Paeslack could not imagine that anyone would have made such considerations. He sees the reason in that these plans could never have been implemented anyway because we have a relatively rigid regulatory framework and corset regarding the technical tests we can conduct.
context: Witness testimony showing KBA personnel claimed they lacked legal authority to conduct software testing, presenting regulatory constraints as insurmountable.

label: KBA lacked expertise and resources for software analysis
original_label: KBA lacked expertise and resources for software analysis
quote: Die zeugen des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes haben erhebliche fachliche Schwächen und personelle Engpässe in der Behörde aufgezeigt. Auch diese Mängel haben neben dem Unwillen der Behörden dazu beigetragen, dass Abschalteinrichtungen nicht früher entdeckt wurden. Bei den rechtlichen Vorschriften zur Fahrzeuggenehmigung handelt es sich um eine umfassende und komplexe Rechtsmaterie, bei der nationales und europäisches Recht stark miteinander verwoben sind. Der Leiter des Referates Typgenehmigungserteilungen, der Zeuge Klaus Pietsch, hat dies folgendermaßen beschrieben: 'Typgenehmigungserteilungen muss man sich so vorstellen, dass wir nach 250 Einzelrechtsakten Genehmigungen erteilen.' In seinem Referat haben sich jedoch im Regelfall keine Juristen mit diesen Vorschriften befasst.
english_gloss: Witnesses from the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt demonstrated significant technical weaknesses and personnel bottlenecks in the authority. These deficiencies, alongside bureaucratic unwillingness, contributed to defeat devices not being detected earlier. Vehicle approval regulations are comprehensive and complex legal matters in which national and European law are strongly intertwined. The head of the type-approval department, witness Klaus Pietsch, described it as follows: 'Type approvals should be understood as issuing approvals based on 250 individual legal acts.' However, lawyers typically did not work with these regulations in his department.
context: Report documenting that KBA lacked the legal expertise and personnel to conduct software reviews during type-approval process.

label: KBA overwhelmed with workload after scandal became public
original_label: KBA overwhelmed with workload after scandal became public
quote: Auch personelle Umstrukturierungen konnten am absoluten Personalmangel nichts ändern: 'Wir sind dadurch natürlich auch stärker, stärkere Mannschaft, aber immer noch zu wenig.' Der Zeuge Klaus Pietsch beklagte sich, dass seine Behörde mit Bekanntwerden des Abgasskandals schließlich vollends überlastet war und 'dass wir aufgrund der besonderen Situation, die wir seit September 2015 haben, nicht immer ganz nach Geschäftsverteilungsplan arbeiten können, sondern eben dort mit den entsprechenden Kapazitäten haushalten müssen und dann die Leute quasi das eine oder andere, was vielleicht nicht im Organisationsplan drinsteht, dann doch tun, damit man die Arbeit bewältigt bekommt'.
english_gloss: Personnel reorganization could not change the absolute personnel shortage: 'We are of course a stronger team through this, a stronger team, but still too few.' Witness Klaus Pietsch complained that his authority was completely overwhelmed once the diesel scandal became public, and 'because of the special situation we have had since September 2015, we cannot always work exactly according to our organizational plan, but must instead manage with available capacities, and then people essentially do this or that, which perhaps is not in the organizational plan, just so we can manage the work.'
context: KBA leadership testimony revealing severe staffing constraints and organizational chaos following scandal disclosure.

label: Earnings-per-share growth targets and analyst expectations
original_label: Earnings-per-share growth targets and analyst expectations
quote: The scheme's objectives were, among other things, to report recurring earnings that falsely appeared to grow smoothly by approximately 15 to 20 percent annually; to meet or exceed the published expectations of securities analysts forecasting Enron's reported earnings-per-share and other results; to conceal and avoid publicly reporting any large write-downs or losses; to persuade investors through false and misleading statements that Enron's profitability would continue to grow; to deceive credit rating agencies in order to maintain an investment-grade credit rating; to deceive the investing public about the true magnitude of growing debt and other obligations required to keep the company's varied and often unsuccessful business ventures afloat; to increase artificially Enron's reported cash flow in order to mask a growing disparity between the company's reported revenues and its actual earnings from operations; and to artificially inflate the share price of Enron's stock.
context: The indictment describes the scheme's core financial targets as stated by prosecutors in their factual recital of the conspiracy.

label: Budget targets predetermined and backed into through accounting
original_label: Budget targets predetermined and backed into through accounting
quote: Defendants JEFFREY K.SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY were among the principal architects and operators of the scheme to manipulate Enron's reported financial results and to present Enron in a misleading manner. Together with their coconspirators, they set annual and quarterly earnings and cash flow targets (budget targets) for the company as a whole and for each of Enron's business units. In furtherance of the scheme to defraud, SKILLING and CAUSEY, together with their coconspirators and others, predetermined Enron's budget targets and backed into those targets through, among other things, the use of deceptive accounting devices.
context: Prosecutors describe how Skilling and Causey set specific annual and quarterly financial targets that were predetermined rather than derived from expected operational performance.

label: Targets set by growth mandates not operational projections
original_label: Targets set by growth mandates not operational projections
quote: Defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators set the targets by determining the numbers necessary for each Enron business unit to produce in order to meet Enron's mandates for growth and analysts' expectations, rather than by determining how much earnings and cash flow that a particular business unit could reasonably be expected to generate.
context: Prosecutors explain that targets were derived from predetermined growth mandates and analyst expectations rather than realistic operational forecasts.

label: Hundreds of millions in earnings shortfalls requiring artificial levers
original_label: Hundreds of millions in earnings shortfalls requiring artificial levers
quote: On a quarterly and year-end basis, SKILLING and CAUSEY and others assessed Enron's progress toward its budget targets. When the budget targets were not met through actual results from business operations, the desired targets were achieved through the use of various earnings and cash flow levers, including but not limited to those described in this Superseding Indictment. These levers were designed to manipulate Enron's finances and prop up its stock price by, among other things, filling earnings and cash flow shortfalls that were at times in the hundreds of millions of dollars. These shortfalls were referred to within Enron variously as the gap, stretch or overview.
context: Prosecutors describe the routine occurrence of significant shortfalls between budget targets and actual operational performance, which prompted use of manipulation devices.

label: Business operations consistently failed to meet budget targets
original_label: Business operations consistently failed to meet budget targets
quote: In fact, as SKILLING and CAUSEY well knew, beginning at least in the fourth quarter of 2999, Enron consistently failed to meet budget targets through normal business operations and was able to appear successful only because of the scheme described in this Superseding Indictment.
context: Prosecutors state that from Q4 1999 onward, Enron's actual business operations could not generate the targeted earnings without fraudulent accounting.

label: Stock price depends on meeting analyst earnings expectations
original_label: Stock price depends on meeting analyst earnings expectations
quote: The price of Enron's stock was influenced by factors such as Enron's reported revenue, earnings, debt, cash flow, and credit rating, as well as its growth potential and ability to meet consistently revenue and earnings targets and forecasts. Enron's management provided guidance to the investing public regarding anticipated revenue and earnings for upcoming reporting periods. Such guidance was communicated in presentations and conference calls to securities analysts and in other public statements by Enron executives. Relying in part on the company's guidance, securities analysts disseminated to the public their own estimates of the company's expected performance. These earnings estimates, or analysts' expectations, were closely followed by investors. Typically, if a company announced earnings that failed to meet or exceed analysts' expectations, the price of the company's stock declined.
context: Prosecutors explain the market dynamic that tied Enron's stock price to meeting analyst expectations, creating pressure to report specific earnings figures.

label: Investment grade credit rating critical to business operations
original_label: Investment grade credit rating critical to business operations
quote: It was critical to Enron's ongoing business operations that it maintain an investment grade rating for its debt, which was rated by national rating agencies. An investment grade rating was essential to Enron's ability to enter into trading contracts with its counterparties and to maintain sufficient lines of credit with major banks. In order to maintain an investment grade rating, Enron was required to demonstrate that its financial condition was stable and that the risk that Enron would not repay its debts and other financial obligations was low. The credit rating agencies relied on, among other things, Enron's public filings, including its financial statements filed with the SEC, in rating Enron's debt. In addition, members of Enron's senior management met regularly with, and provided financial and other information to, representatives of credit rating agencies. Two primary factors influencing Enron's credit rating and the willingness of banks to extend loans to Enron were Enron's total amount of debt and other obligations and its cash flow.
context: Prosecutors describe how maintaining an investment-grade credit rating depended on reported financial metrics, creating pressure to report favorable numbers.

label: California energy market created windfall impossible to conceal legitimately
original_label: California energy market created windfall impossible to conceal legitimately
quote: During 2000 and 2001, the profitability of Enron's wholesale energy trading business, primarily based in its Enron Wholesale business unit, dramatically increased for reasons including rapidly rising energy prices in the western United States, especially in California. This sudden and large increase in trading profits, which exceeded $1 billion, if disclosed to the public, would have made it apparent that Enron Wholesale's revenues were closely tied to the market price for energy, and that Enron therefore was exposed to the risk of a decline in such prices. Such disclosure would have undermined Enron's description and presentation of itself as the dominant intermediator in the energy markets, rather than as a speculative (and therefore risky) trading company whose stock would trade at a much lower price-to-earnings ratio.
context: Prosecutors explain that legitimate accounting would require disclosing Enron's exposure to energy price volatility, which would contradict the company's market positioning and hurt the stock price.

label: EES massive losses could not be accommodated in budget targets
original_label: EES massive losses could not be accommodated in budget targets
quote: They accomplished this at the close of the first quarter of 2001 through a reorganization designed to conceal the existence and magnitude of EES's unexpectedly severe business failure. Enron hid that failure from the investing public by moving large portions of EES's business - which defendants JEFFREY K.SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and others knew at the time otherwise would have to report hundreds of millions of dollars in losses - into Enron Wholesale, which was the Enron business segment housing most of the company's wholesale energy trading operations and income.
context: Prosecutors describe how EES losses could not be legitimately reported without breaking the company's financial targets and segment reporting, forcing a reorganization to conceal them.

category: Incentives and rewards tied to targets
label: Executive compensation enriched from stock price inflation and bonus targets
original_label: Executive compensation enriched from stock price inflation and bonus targets
quote: During this time, the rise in Enron's stock price enriched defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators through salary, bonuses, grants of artificially appreciating stock and stock options, and prestige within their professions and communities. Between 1998 and 2001, SKILLING received approximately $200 million from the sale of Enron stock options and restricted stock, netting over $89 million in profit, and was paid more than $14 million in salary and bonuses. Between 1998 and 2001, CAUSEY received more than $14 million from the sale of Enron stock and stock options, netting over $5 million in profit, and was paid more than $4 million in salary and bonuses.
context: Prosecutors document the substantial financial rewards that accrued to Skilling and Causey from the inflated stock price and bonus compensation tied to meeting targets.

category: Incentives and rewards tied to targets
label: LJM partnership compensation for achieving financial reporting objectives
original_label: LJM partnership compensation for achieving financial reporting objectives
quote: SKILLING, CAUSEY, Fastow and others then exploited Fastow's dual role as a means to ensure that LJM did not act as a truly independent third party investor would have, but rather as Enron's own vehicle to achieve its financial reporting objectives and as a means for Fastow and others to be heavily compensated for contributing to Enron's success in meeting its financial reporting objectives.
context: Prosecutors describe how Fastow was compensated through LJM specifically for enabling transactions that achieved Enron's financial reporting targets.

label: Reserve account manipulated to report targeted earnings-per-share
original_label: Reserve account manipulated to report targeted earnings-per-share
quote: In order to help achieve the earnings-per-share target that defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY wanted to report publicly, a senior Enron executive improperly released into earnings millions of dollars from a prudency reserve account in Enron's energy trading business, which purportedly existed so that Enron would not report more energy trading earnings than it actually expected to collect. This release of millions of dollars from the prudency reserve account was not done for legitimate business or accounting objectives. It was done solely to accomplish defendants SKILLING's and CAUSEY's desire to publicly report a higher earnings per share number than expected by securities analysts for the second quarter 2000, and thereby artificially inflate and support Enron's share price.
context: Prosecutors describe the deliberate decision to manipulate a reserve account specifically to meet the predetermined earnings-per-share target for Q2 2000.

label: Asset values fraudulently increased to close budget shortfall
original_label: Asset values fraudulently increased to close budget shortfall
quote: For example, in the fourth quarter of 2000, under the direction of CAUSEY and others, Enron personnel fraudulently increased the value of one of the largest of Enron's merchant assets, Mariner Energy, by $100 million in order to help close a budget shortfall.
context: Prosecutors document a specific decision to inflate asset values to achieve the quarterly budget target when operations fell short.

label: Project Grayhawk scheme to record stock price appreciation as operating earnings
original_label: Project Grayhawk scheme to record stock price appreciation as operating earnings
quote: Knowing that Enron's presentation about EBS at its January 20, 2000 conference with securities analysts was designed to, and likely would, cause an immediate increase in Enron's stock price, defendants JEFFREY K.SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators constructed and approved a scheme to allow Enron to record and report as earnings from operations $85 million of what in reality was just the increase in Enron's share price caused by the EBS presentation. Through its energy trading and assets business, Enron recorded earnings from a partnership interest it held in a large energy investment named JEDI. JEDI's capital consisted, in part, of Enron stock. When Enron's stock price rose, the value of JEDI rose. In September 1999, JEDI hedged its Enron stock through a transaction with Enron that fixed the value of the Enron stock at a set price. Just before the January 20, 2000 analyst conference, Enron executed a series of transactions, in a project known as Grayhawk, that temporarily removed the fixed hedge and replaced it with an open one that did not limit the upside gain to JEDI from increases in value of the Enron stock. After the conference, the fixed hedge was then reinstated at Enron's then higher share price.
context: Prosecutors describe the deliberate design and execution of a scheme to manufacture operating earnings by exploiting a temporary hedge modification before and after a planned stock price increase.

label: False statements about EBS network and valuation to boost stock
original_label: False statements about EBS network and valuation to boost stock
quote: At the January 20, 2000 analyst conference, defendant JEFFREY K. SKILLING and his coconspirators knowingly made false and misleading statements about EBS. SKILLING stated, among other things, that EBS has already established the superior broadband delivery network; that EBS has built this network . . . and we are turning on the switch; that the critical network control software was in Enron's possession and incorporated and used in its network; and that Enron valued the business at $30 billion, which SKILLING called a conservative valuation. In SKILLING's presence, EBS's CO-CEO Joseph Hirko stated that EBS possessed advance network control software and that it was no pipe dream. In reality, EBS had neither the claimed broadband network in place, nor the critical proprietary network control software to run it. The claims about EBS remained only unproven concepts and laboratory demonstrations that SKILLING was advised would take years to complete and might never be realized. In addition, the valuation of the business was inflated by billions of dollars over what internal and external valuations had advised SKILLING might be supportable.
context: Prosecutors describe deliberate false statements to analysts about EBS capabilities and valuation, knowing they were false and that the statements would drive the stock price up.

label: Raptor structure designed with side deal guaranteeing LJM return
original_label: Raptor structure designed with side deal guaranteeing LJM return
quote: As defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY well knew, the Raptor I structure was invalid under applicable accounting rules because Talon was not independent from Enron, and LJM's investment in Talon was not sufficiently at risk to qualify as outside equity. CAUSEY and Fastow had an oral side deal that LJM would receive its initial investment of $30 million in Talon plus a profit of $11 million from Enron, all prior to Talon engaging in any of the hedging transactions for which it was created. As a quid pro quo for this payment to LJM, Fastow agreed with CAUSEY that Enron employees could use Raptor I to manipulate Enron's balance sheet including by allowing Enron employees, without negotiation or due diligence on behalf of LJM, to select the values at which the Enron assets were hedged with Talon.
context: Prosecutors describe how the Raptor structure was deliberately designed with a side deal knowing it violated accounting rules, to enable balance sheet manipulation to meet financial targets.

label: Cuiaba project parked with LJM to record false earnings
original_label: Cuiaba project parked with LJM to record false earnings
quote: One such transaction involved LJM's purchase of Enron's interest in a company that was building a power plant in Cuiaba, Brazil (the Cuiaba project). On September 30, 1999, when no true third-party buyer could be found, Enron sold a portion of its interest in the Cuiaba project to LJM for $11.3 million. LJM agreed to buy this interest only because defendants JEFFREY K.SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY, Fastow and others, in an undisclosed side deal, agreed that Enron would buy back the interest, if necessary, at a profit to LJM. Based on this purported sale, which was in fact an asset parking or warehousing arrangement, Enron improperly recognized approximately $65 million in income in the third and fourth quarters of 1999, when it was straining to meet budget targets designed to ensure that it achieved its earnings-per-share goals.
context: Prosecutors describe the decision to structure a false asset sale to LJM specifically when Enron was straining to meet earnings-per-share targets, with a concealed buyback guarantee.

label: Nigerian barges parked with Merrill Lynch to record budget target earnings
original_label: Nigerian barges parked with Merrill Lynch to record budget target earnings
quote: One transaction used by Enron to ensure that its target was met in the fourth quarter of 1999 was a deal whereby Enron sold Merrill Lynch an interest in electricity-generating power barges moored off the coast of Nigeria.
